verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly state LangSmith provides Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java SDKs for tracing/integration (langsmith-docs-24), and the GitHub repo confirms native Python and JS integration with example usage (langsmith-gh-1, langsmith-gh-3). This directly satisfies the story of instrumenting apps in both Python and JS/TS with official SDKs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically for the JS/TS SDK and clearer parity details between the two SDKs beyond a single Python code snippet.
